# Future Ammunition - Project TNI

`jmfsb_fa_tni`

Future Ammunition in the TNI magazines the jmfsb factions issue: each one loaded with the FA round of its calibre, at tiers 2-4, in a jmfsb well the mod's weapons take. Written by `tools/gen_mod_factions.py`.

## Requires

- `cba_main` _(external)_
- `ace_ballistics` _(external)_
- `jmfsb_fa_ammo`
- `jmfsb_fa_tiers`
- `ptni_dmr_f` _(external)_
- `ptni_pistol_f` _(external)_
- `ptni_ss2_f` _(external)_

Carries `skipWhenMissingDependencies` - the PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when something above is absent.
